## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and relevant manual checks. State any checks not performed.
For UI changes, include screenshots using synthetic text only.

- [ ] Relevant build/tests pass, or the limitation is explained above.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any setup or behavioral changes.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, real drafts/history, local IDE state, or build output.
- [ ] New source/assets are compatible with the MIT license and have appropriate attribution.
